summary: Complaints centre on stray dogs, LPG cylinder shortages and black-marketing, leopard sightings and a nagar panchayat too small for development, while appreciation is thin and mostly limited to a CHC X-ray machine and approved road and expressway works.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row 40: Naugawan Sadat, Amroha, None); AC extent also from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naugawan_Sadat_Assembly_constituency (Amroha tehsil: Naugawan Sadat, Kailsa, Naugawan Sadat NP; 15 gram panchayats in Hasanpur tehsil)

positives.english: CHC Naugawan Sadat got a digital X-ray machine, no need to travel far now
positives.hindi: सीएचसी नौगांवा सादात में एक्स-रे मशीन लगी, अब दूर नहीं जाना पड़ेगा
positives.basis: Digital X-ray machines delivered to four CHCs including Naugawan Sadat; technicians posted; CMO said patients would be spared travel and private test costs of Rs 300-400 (district-level article covering Rahra, Hasanpur, Dhabarsi and Naugawan Sadat CHCs)

positives.english: Ganga Expressway stretch in Hasanpur is largely built now
positives.hindi: गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे का हसनपुर वाला हिस्सा लगभग बन चुका है
positives.basis: District-level: Hasanpur section (23.60 km) of Ganga Expressway in Amroha reported largely built, road, lighting and drainage finished, final work pending; article says 'completely completed' yet 'only the final work is going on'; planned completion 12 Oct 2025. AC membership of this stretch unconfirmed; current status not verified

positives.english: Development works were inaugurated in Amroha, now people want to see results
positives.hindi: अमरोहा में विकास कार्यों का लोकार्पण हुआ, अब नतीजे दिखें
positives.basis: District-level: CM Yogi inaugurated and laid foundation stones for 43 projects worth Rs 207.49 crore for Amroha and Dhanaura ACs (25 projects, Rs 104.35 crore, in Amroha AC); no Naugawan Sadat project is named in the coverage

positives.english: Inference: approved repairs for Naugawan Sadat roads, hope work starts soon
positives.hindi: *नौगांवा सादात की सड़कों की मरम्मत मंजूर हुई, काम शुरू हो
positives.basis: Inference: approval only, no start or completion reported; the Naugawan Sadat road is one of nine Dhanaura, Naugawan Sadat and Hasanpur roads with Rs 1.29 crore repair sanctioned by PWD. Treated as a weak positive pending field check

positives.english: Inference: industrial park coming up in Hasanpur, hope for local jobs
positives.hindi: *हसनपुर में औद्योगिक पार्क बन रहा है, रोजगार की उम्मीद
positives.basis: Inference: the CM's event coverage says an industrial park is under development in Hasanpur; it is not stated whether it is inside this AC or among the 43 inaugurated projects. Job benefit is not stated in the source

negatives.english: Hours in LPG queues and still no cylinder, black market at Rs 1200 to 1500
negatives.hindi: सिलिंडर के लिए घंटों लाइन, फिर भी गैस नहीं मिलती, ब्लैक में महंगा
negatives.basis: AC-specific (town of Naugawan Sadat): LPG queues outside agency warehouses in Naugawan Sadat, Hasanpur, Mandi Dhanora and Joya from Thursday morning; consumers say cylinders sold black at Rs 1200-1500 and agencies overcharge; no official response in the article

negatives.english: Stray dogs bit eight people in one day in Naugawan Sadat
negatives.hindi: नौगांवा सादात में आवारा कुत्तों का आतंक, एक दिन में आठ लोगों को काटा
negatives.basis: AC-specific (town): on 11 May 2026 stray dogs bit eight people in a few hours, mainly Mohalla Papad Talab; CHC gave anti-rabies injections to 28 people; residents demanded dogs be relocated and a permanent solution; no official statement reported

negatives.english: Nagar panchayat is too small, little room left for development work
negatives.hindi: नगर पंचायत का दायरा छोटा है, विकास के लिए जगह कम बची है
negatives.basis: AC-specific (Naugawan Sadat nagar panchayat): MLA Samarpal Singh wrote to government that the nagar panchayat has little room left for development and asked to add Khedi, Badshahpur and Bilna; government asked SDM for a report within a week

negatives.english: Video of police clerk beating a complainant at the police station went viral, allegation
negatives.hindi: थाने में फरियादी की पिटाई का वीडियो वायरल, आरोप है
negatives.basis: AC-specific (Naugawan Sadat police station, in the town): three videos showed the head clerk beating a complainant; SP sent him to police lines pending inquiry; allegation as reported by the article

negatives.english: Leopard sightings in Nagla and Budhanpur villages have people scared
negatives.hindi: नगला और बुढ़नपुर में तेंदुआ दिखने से लोग दहशत में हैं
negatives.basis: AC membership unconfirmed: Nagla is described as near Naugawan Sadat (Didauli area) and Budhanpur is near Didauli police station; the article is about Amroha district. Residents demanded surveillance and a cage

notes: AC confirmed as No. 40 Naugawan Sadat, Amroha district, reserved None (Wikipedia list). Wikipedia AC page lists Naugawan Sadat, Kailsa and Naugawan Sadat NP (Amroha tehsil) plus 15 gram panchayats in Hasanpur tehsil; the Hasanpur GP list was not checked against official maps. Current MLA is inconsistent across sources (Wikipedia list and Samarpal Singh page say Samarpal Singh, SP, 2022; infobox and a mirror say 2020 or Sangeeta Chauhan); verify on the UP assembly site. Positives 4 and 5 are weak inferences from approvals and an under-development project, not delivered benefits; positive 2 status is contradictory in its source. Leopard item is AC-unconfirmed and not counted in ac_specific_negatives. Oct 2026 leopard carcass in a Naugawan Sadat town orchard was seen but not used. No local news found on sugarcane dues, water supply, electricity or the Naugawan Sadat road condition; Simbhaoli and Dhanaura mill items are not in this AC. Field check recommended on dog bites, LPG supply, and whether any Hasanpur or Naugawan Sadat road work has actually started.
